_comment: 'When this attacks a hero, if you have more {h} than them, this gets go again.' The three printings had THREE DIFFERENT implementations for identical text: red wrapped its conditions in a redundant AND, yellow had them flat, and blue was a PLAY ability missing the ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate entirely and spelling the keyword 'go again' with a space, which an exact GO_AGAIN match skips. All three now use the one shape loader.conditional_keywords() recognises. Precedent: scar_for_a_scar_red. WHILE_STATIC rather than TRIGGERED because CR 6.2.3d evaluates a conditional static-continuous effect at all times.
